items.name: Race the Clock Minnesota 2023
items.information:
This will be the final competition of the year in Minnesota! Come celebrate another year of cubing with us!

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcDAwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9d340df17a1aec4ba42677c10d4db2f31757ffba/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

# No outside food or drink is allowed in the venue, please take note of this. 

All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering
 
**How to Change/Cancel Your Registration**

Competitors can change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information:
1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

Competitors can also modify their registration through the Register tab.

In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund ($18.75 USD).

The deadline to change/cancel your registration is December 23rd , 2023, 6:00 PM Mountain Time.

**Waitlist Procedure**

If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until December 23rd at 6:00 PM MST. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.
